sermons.title: A Call to be Holy - Part 2
sermons.description: Part 2 of the sermon given by Elder Graeme Coetzee.

sermons.title: A Call to be Holy
sermons.description: Peter's encouragement for all Christians to live holy lives. He uses the illustration to gird the loins of our minds, and to be holy as our God is holy. We see the reverence and awe that we should have for God as we serve him in our daily lives.

sermons.title: A Salvation Worth Searching for
sermons.description: We continue to explore the hope that believers have in Christ amidst suffering. We delve deeper into the prophets's message of hope, and how even Angels desire to look into the salvation that is ours in Christ. We also discuss how this hope should shape our perspective and actions as we navigate the challenges of life.

sermons.title: An Encouragement to Fathers
sermons.description: An encouragement to fathers, drawing from Paul's exhortation to serve wholeheartedly as unto the Lord. We explore the importance of leading by example, and how fathers can have a loving relationship with their wives and children while honoring God in all they do.

sermons.title: A Living Hope for a Suffering People - Part 1
sermons.description: In this message, we explore the living hope that believers have in Christ, as described by Peter in his first epistle. We examine the nature of this hope, its source in the resurrection of Jesus, and how it sustains us through trials and suffering. We also consider the implications of this hope for our daily lives and our eternal future.

sermons.title: An Introduction to Peter
sermons.description: In this message, we introduce the book of 1 Peter, exploring its context and the themes that run throughout the epistle. We examine Peter's audience, his purpose in writing, and how his teachings remain relevant for believers today as we navigate trials and seek to live holy lives in a hostile world.

sermons.title: The Prayer of Faith and Confession
sermons.description: In this message, we delve into the power of prayer and the importance of confession, as taught by James. We explore how the prayer of faith can bring healing, restoration, and spiritual strength, and how confessing our sins to one another fosters accountability and community within the body of Christ.

sermons.title: Patience in suffering
sermons.description: In this message, we explore the theme of patience in suffering, drawing from James' exhortation to remain steadfast in the face of trials. We consider the examples of the prophets and the endurance of Job, learning how to cultivate a resilient faith that trusts in God's timing and justice.

sermons.title: What your wealth says about you
sermons.description: James delivers a powerful warning to the wealthy, exposing the dangers of materialism and the consequences of exploiting others for personal gain. This message challenges us to examine our attitudes toward wealth and to live with integrity and compassion in light of God's judgment.

sermons.title: Godly Influence of Lois and Eunice
sermons.description: This message explores the godly influence of Lois and Eunice, the grandmother and mother of Timothy, and how their faith shaped his spiritual journey. Drawing from Paul's letter to Timothy, we see the importance of a faithful heritage and the impact of godly mentors in the life of a believer.
